column4: https://statemediamonitor.com/2026/05/radio-television-national-congolaise-rtnc/",,,"STATUS: active. Drafted 2026-10-20 by automated research; sources as listed. Existence rests on the official statute (Décret n°09/62 of 03.12.2009, JO 15.06.2010); activity in 2026 is shown by press (Radio Okapi, 15.06.2026: RTNC World Cup coverage) and the secondary State Media Monitor profile (May 2026). RTNC's own site rtnc.cd could not be opened (fetch refused: not in a search result), so nothing RTNC discloses about itself was read; domain and YouTube rest on State Media Monitor: verify on rtnc.cd first. HEAD CONFLICT: ACP (15.11.2022) reported ordinances naming Sylvie Elenge Nyembo DG, José-Adolphe Voto Tongba DGA and Floribert Lubota Ngwangu PCA; State Media Monitor (May 2026) still lists Elenge (present at a 09.10.2025 redevance protocol); Radio Okapi (15.06.2026) quotes Didier M'Boy as DG. The field holds the newest report; verify the presidential ordinance. Earlier heads: Ernest Kabila Ilunga (DG 2018 until his death 25.06.2021, AUB obituary https://www.uar-aub.org/single-post/obituary-the-ceo-of-the-congolese-radio-and-television-is-no-more); acting DG Freddy Mulumba suspended Dec 2021 by Minister Patrick Muyaya, interim Bellidée Robert Bunga (infos.cd 14.12.2021, https://infos.cd/dossier/medias-freddy-mulumba-suspendu-de-ses-fonctions-de-dg-ai-de-la-rtnc/4756). Share 100 is State Media Monitor's figure; the decree makes RTNC a public establishment (no share capital stated). Licence-fee collection rate lowered from 10% to 2.4% by inter-ministerial decree No. 15/CAB/MIN-COMEDIA/PMK/2025 of 12.09.2025 (State Media Monitor, not read in the official text). year_founded left empty: the 2009 decree transformed the existing RTNC (successor of OZRT) into an établissement public; the original creation date of the RTNC name was not confirmed. No annual report or budget figures found. State Media Monitor classes RTNC as State Controlled (2022-2026). Moved to notes before import (sources name two different heads in 2026; the decree is the founding act, not a registration number): editor_in_chief ""Didier M'Boy (Directeur général, as quoted by Radio Okapi on 15.06.2026; appointment act not found)""; registration_number ""(établissement public à caractère socio-culturel; statutes fixed by Décret n°09/62 du 03 décembre 2009)"".",media
